title: RCARequest (Module B -> Module C, POST /rca)
description: Proposed contract; confirm with the Module B owner. bbox = [x_min, y_min, x_max, y_max] in ORIGINAL-image pixels.

status.description: Detector-side inspection status, e.g. review_required. Informational.

defects.description: May be empty. Maximum length is configurable (RCA_MAX_DEFECTS, default 20).

class.description: Must be one of the configured classes (Module A class map).

bbox.description: x_max > x_min, y_max > y_min, all >= 0 and <= image size when given.

image_width.description: Optional; must be sent together with image_height; enables bounds checking.
